title: Attention and the transformer, from the inside

videos.script: Lesson fourteen ended on a wall. At fifty steps, the LSTM could not recall the first symbol. {{wall}} This lesson builds the model that replaced it, one piece at a time. {{lookup}} The piece at the centre is attention, and it is a lookup made soft. Every token asks a question, and every token answers with a score. {{matrix}} The scores become weights that add up to one. The answer is a weighted average. For four tokens it is a four by four table, and you compute it by hand. {{mask}} A triangular mask hides the future, so a model can learn to predict the next word. {{heads}} Several heads look in different ways at once, for the same number of weights. {{order}} Attention alone cannot see order. Shuffle the input, and the output shuffles with it. Positions fix that. {{block}} Add a layer norm, a small network and two shortcuts, and you have the transformer block. {{recall}} Then the test from lesson fourteen, with the same budget and the same data. One block, half the size of the LSTM, names the first of fifty symbols in every test sequence. {{inside}} Inside, the last position looks straight back at the first. The distance is one step. {{end}}
